report: OBSERVED: The revised allocation closes both prior findings. P-TS-01 now identifies the changed index/refresh composition wiring, specifies what must survive, and combines a deterministic prefix-and-order check with stamp tests and bounded source-diff inspection of initialization placement. HEAD compose.rs confirms initialization follows scanning and precedes ensure_repo on both paths. P-TS-04 now distinguishes test-count floors from preservation evidence: TS-C09 compares the attributes, names and bodies of the 179 pre-existing #[test] items in editable files, while byte-identity checks cover other files. OBSERVED: git status contains only the two untracked deliverables and pinned decision record; git diff is empty because they are untracked. All 23 manifest digests match the tree. BUILDER-EXECUTED: the allocation validator reported nine valid checks and the TS-C09 self-check passed. NOT RUN independently: cargo and rmap, as prohibited for this document review. The validator could not run independently in this read-only sandbox because tsx could not create its IPC socket (EPERM); this is not evidence of an allocation defect. Acceptance is of the requirements/design allocation, not implementation. The actual implementation checks and L06’s real-upgrade field criterion remain unexecuted; the latter is explicitly deferred under D-TS-RUNTIME-1.
